title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go; parity fixes and version bumps
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: We have duplicated auth/retry logic and slightly different streaming ergonomics across the three official SDKs. This causes maintenance burden and subtle parity bugs when we introduce changes to the API surface (streaming callbacks, retry backoffs, and token refresh semantics). This PR unifies the behavior and brings parity across Python, TypeScript, and Go.

What changed (high level): unified auth token refresh semantics (background refresh + transparent retries on 401/403), standardized retry/backoff configuration across SDKs, refactored streaming APIs to a consistent model (subscribe/cancelable iterator / AsyncIterator parity), ergonomics improvements for common use-cases (context managers in Python, auto-close in TS, ctx.Context integration in Go), and version bumps for all three SDK packages. Also includes small perf fixes and updated tests and docs.

Compatibility and migration notes: default behavior remains backwards-compatible for most users. Notable changes: default retry policy slightly more conservative (max_retries increased from 3 to 4 with jitter); streaming API surface has a new ergonomic utility in each SDK (e.g., Python: StreamingResponse.iter_lines() and context-managed client). Consumers using internal retry/backoff knobs should review the new names (retry_policy -> retry_config). See release notes and changelog entries included in this PR.

Testing: added end-to-end tests for auth refresh under heavy load, streaming contract tests that run the same scenarios across all three SDKs using the eval-harness, and updated unit tests for retry edge cases (429 vs 503 vs 401).

Related: ENG-4821 (unify SDK retry semantics), ENG-4830 (streaming ergonomics parity).

review_comments: Jared Bloom: Please double-check that token refresh is non-blocking for streaming requests; we had an incident where a refresh blocked the event loop.
Asha Patel: Addressed - moved refresh to background thread/task and added a small buffer window before expiry to avoid refresh storms. Added tests to cover streaming + refresh interleaving.
Liang Wu: Typescript AbortableStream looks good, but can we make cancel idempotent?
Asha Patel: Updated AbortableStream.cancel() to be idempotent and added unit tests.
Marta Gonzalez: Go changes look fine; ensure ctx cancellation flows through retries and streaming loops (added a note).
Asha Patel: Confirmed - retries observe ctx.Done(), streaming adapter returns on ctx cancellation; added e2e test.
Jared Bloom: CI flake on macos-latest due to slow test - marked flaky and added retry in CI matrix.
release_notes: Unify auth token refresh and retry policies across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs, standardize streaming ergonomics (new helper APIs), bump SDK package versions. Migration notes: rename retry_policy -> retry_config for advanced configuration; streaming helpers are additive and opt-in. See docs/sdks/migration-auth-retries.md for full migration guide.
